mapper.select: SELECT m.user_id AS userId, m.nickname AS nickname, m.email AS email, m.provider AS provider, a.account_created_at AS joinDate FROM member m LEFT JOIN account a ON a.user_id = m.user_id WHERE m.user_id = #{userId} AND deleted_at IS NULL LIMIT 1
SELECT user_id AS userId, provider AS provider, password AS password FROM member WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND deleted_at IS NULL LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE member SET deleted_at = NOW(), email = CONCAT(email, '_del_', user_id), nickname = CONCAT(nickname, '_del_', user_id) WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
